text_block_list.name: Cheers
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Ngh... I fell short...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I'm so, so, so, so frustrated—!!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I should've had a great 130-mile run!!
I was aiming for a record, too!! Why?!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I'm so seriously frustrateddddd!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Gran-chan...—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(Gran-chan hasn't realized it yet,
but I saw it—)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(In today's race...
To be blunt, Gran-chan was just unlucky.)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(Every move made by the other racers, myself included,
ended up working against Gran-chan.)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(Gran-chan's natural ability was supposed to be
far above ours...
That's why it feels so frustrating—)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: —...I've decided!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Loves-chan.
I'm dropping out of the Oaks!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Because I lost at my own distance.
At this rate, there's no way I can win the Oaks either...!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
More... more, more!
I'll hone my mile to perfection!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
And this time for sure!
I'll prove I'm the strongest at the mile!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...Gran-chan really is always Gran-chan,
isn't she?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(I have to face forward like Gran-chan
and make my running even stronger...!)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Then I will win the Oaks.
Let's both hone our own running...!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...!
I'm not gonna lose...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
――...Both Love-chan and Gran-chan
far exceeded my expectations.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I need to hone it... more, and even more.
My "Genesis Method"...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...I lost.
choice_data_list: Still, that was a great run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Although we didn't win,
we gained plenty of fruitful results for the next race.
Today's defeat will surely become fuel for the future...!"
choice_data_list: We're the ones who will win the Oaks.
We're the ones who are going to win the Oaks!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Geez.
You're trying a little too hard to look cool♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu—
That's what I love about you, though♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...We have to win the Oaks, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And so, while victory eluded her in the Oka Sho,
the race gave her the strength to take another step forward."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "The Oaks will soon be upon us. As if it can hardly wait for the birth of a new Queen of the Oaks—"
